my_cnf_path.description: Path to the .my.cnf file containing MySQL connection credentials (user, password, host, port, socket).

user.description: MySQL username for the exporter. If set, overrides the user in .my.cnf.

password.description: MySQL password for the exporter. If set, overrides the password in .my.cnf.

listen_address.description: Network address and port the exporter will bind to. Use host:port format (e.g., '127.0.0.1:9104').

disable_collectors.description: List of collector names to disable (e.g., ['process', 'slave_host']). See upstream docs for valid names.

items.description: Name of a collector to disable.

enable_collectors.description: List of collector names to explicitly enable (overrides defaults). Use only if you need non-default collectors.

items.description: Name of a collector to enable.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file for HTTPS endpoint (optional).

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file for HTTPS endpoint (optional).

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to mysqld_exporter (e.g., ['--no-collect.info_schema.tables']).

items.description: A single command-line argument (without leading hyphens if using short forms).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

scrape_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for metrics from MySQL before timing out.

disable_native_metrics.description: Set to 'true' to skip collection of native MySQL metrics (e.g., for compatibility with MariaDB).
